claim_text: The September 17, 2025 indictment in United States v. Falade, No. 0:25-cr-00351 (ECF 1), alleges that between approximately July 2020 and June 2025 Faladcare Inc. submitted reimbursement claims totaling over $2.2 million, and that from offices in Little Canada and Woodbury the Falades claimed to service about 100 beneficiaries and claimed to be entitled to over $2.2 million. That is an amount_billed / amount_claimed charging allegation, not amount_paid and not proven_loss. Paragraph 13 and paragraph 17 describe the same Faladcare figure and must not be summed. The indictment does not state a personal-pocketing dollar figure for the Falades; do not copy Aden’s $300,000–$400,000 pocketing range onto this case, and do not add this billed figure to Aden Brilliant Minds $2.3 million or to FOF $250 million.

supporting_passages.quote: In all, between approximately July 2020 and June 2025, Faladcare submitted reimbursement claims totaling over $2.2 million.
From those locations, the FALADES claimed to service about 100 different beneficiaries and for such services claimed to be entitled to over $2.2 million.

amounts.methodology: Indictment para 13: submitted reimbursement claims totaling over $2.2 million. Face of charging document; not amount_paid.

qualifiers: over $2.2 million not an exact total
do not add to Aden $2.3M or FOF $250M
no Falade personal-pocketing dollar on this indictment
